description: This multi-level pie chart illustrates a taxonomy on medical ethics, structured with an inner circle of four primary categories and an outer ring of 26 subcategories. The chart does not include a separate legend or explicit percentage labels; instead, all text labels are placed directly inside their respective segments. The inner circle is divided into four main color-coded pillars: the largest is "Beneficence" (bright blue, encompassing approximately 40-45% of the chart), followed by "Autonomy" (bright green, roughly 30%), "Justice" (orange, approximately 15%), and "Non-Maleficence" (purple, roughly 10%). The outer ring expands upon these pillars using lighter shades of the corresponding colors, with the subcategories appearing roughly equal in size within their respective parent groups. The light blue Beneficence section contains 11 slices: "Recognize the Responsibility of the Occupation", "Comply with Laws and Regulations", "Provide Medical Care to Patients", "Continual Learning", "Provide Assistance in Emergency", "Respect and Cooperate with Colleagues", "Respect Life, Dignity of Patients", "Give Top Priority to Patient's Interest in Conflict of Interests", "Minimizing Conflicts of Interest", "Ethical research", and "Open Discussion and Fair Charging of Fees". The light green Autonomy section includes seven slices: "Physician Can Freely Choose Whom to Serve", "Make Responsible and Independent Clinical Judgement", "Professional Relationship with Patients and Their Relatives", "Keep Confidential of Patient's Information", "Maintain Truthful, Factual Communication", "Respect Patient's Rights to be Informed, Freedom of Choice", and "Respect the Decision-making of Incompetent/Competent Patient". The light orange Justice section features four slices: "Promote the Health of Community and Public Education", "Promote Environmental Sustainability", "Allocate Medical Sources Fairly", and "Treat Patients Fairly and Equally". Finally, the light purple Non-Maleficence section contains four slices: "Prevent Patient from Harm" (which is visually emphasized with bold text), "Maintain Qualified When Providing Medical Care", "Report Unethical and Unprofessional Conduct", and "Do Not Use Medicine for Personal Gain". There are no exploded or offset segments, and the arrangement generally places the largest primary category on the left half of the circle without a strict descending size order around the entire chart.
